_comment: Model caveats served as hyphaeon://caveats and read by the web app's /methods pages. Keyed by model_version. Numbers transcribed from veg/HyphAeon@3cb9cc6 model_eval/README.md (the 'Current state (hyphaeon_v1)' tables) and from hyphaeon-app/PLAN.md section 2 (model card facts, HuggingFace datamonkey/hyphaeon). Update both places when the model changes.

model_card.what_it_is: A ~1.9M-parameter axial transformer that takes a codon alignment plus a metric tree as four tensors (codon tokens, amino-acid tokens, patristic distance matrix, 4-D MDS coordinates) and emits a per-site MEME-style LRT through a 16-threshold ordinal head.
model_card.evaluated_against: HyPhy MEME, not against known selection
model_card.bundled_weights: backbone + head_meme + head_busted + head_absrel (repo model.safetensors, 9.8 MB); the HuggingFace base file is backbone + head_meme only

headline_numbers.claim: Rank is strong, scale is compressed
Base vs viral variant on unseen viral families

interpretation_rules: Sort by LRT, show rank and percentile within the alignment, show p and BH q but never alone.
Invariable sites are 'not scored', not zero.
Every result is a surrogate for MEME; confirm a site of interest with a real MEME run.
The diagnostics panel classifies the tree regime before the run; on deep trees with >= 100 taxa treat p-values as ordering only.
Choose the variant from tree depth: general for deep cross-species trees, viral for shallow viral trees.
Real submissions are unpublished research: the browser path never transmits sequences; any server path says so before sending.

model_eval.scope: model_eval covers only `hyphaeon meme`; phenotype and epistasis are tested in tests/methods (Mode I baseline). The paper's Mode II (selection-informed PhyloWAS on the attribution tensor) is described but the README notes it is not what the repo implements.

invariance_gates.grid: 6 datasets (3 real + 3 simulated), shallow to deep trees, 18 to 212 taxa, 26% to 100% variable sites

results.details: invariant on majority of 6 datasets; sensitive only on sim_100_deep (r=0.77)
exact r=1.0000 via default automated duplicate haplotype and tree pruning

invariance_gates.reading: The model is nearly invariant to the tree topology and sensitive to branch-length scale (issue #13): branch-length units, reading frame, U-vs-T, silently zeroed missing taxa (#9), silent rescale above patristic 10 (#8), and the 2-taxon bug (#7) all matter more than the topology.

calibration.method: seq-gen neutral simulations, 100 codons unless stated; false-positive rate at alpha = 0.05; threshold <= 10%
calibration.power: Injected amino-acid changes at 10% of sites on 20% of taxa in neutral simulations; true-positive rate reported by the power tests (no headline figure in the README).

composition_bias.reading: Composition is not a confound for the calibration issues seen on large/deep trees.

alignment_length.reading: Output scale is stable across alignment lengths; p-values from different-length alignments are directly comparable.

concordance.method: Spearman rho on variable sites, Cohen's kappa on significant-call agreement, F1 at matched thresholds, against real HyPhy MEME (hyphy 2.5.101)
concordance.reading: In long real genes (Smc6, 1,097 sites) more than 90% of sites are under neutral or purifying evolution with LRT near 0, so rank correlation across the whole variable background measures baseline noise while concordance on the top positively selected sites remains robust.

known_issues.summary: Two-taxon alignments produce a degenerate run
Maximum patristic distance > 10 is rescaled silently by dividing the matrix by the codon count
Alignment taxa missing from the tree are zeroed silently
Nearly invariant to the tree topology, sensitive to branch-length units, reading frame and U-vs-T
known_issues.surface_rule: one set of pre-run checks on every surface

known_issues.summary: ONNX export needs mean_root_attns and root_repr outputs plus busted_head.onnx (reopened with that scope)
known_issues.surface_rule: Phase 0 bridges to Python until the export lands

known_issues.summary: Shallow single-ancestor panels return nothing, silently

measured_cost_python_reference.machine: Apple M4 Pro, torch 2.10, fp32, bundled suite weights, ~1.5 s start-up included
measured_cost_python_reference.scaling: cost scales as sites x taxa^2
